hero.subheadline: Change your life in the Misiones jungle. Intensive programs in Misiones, Argentina. International technique, real practice, active community, and an immersive experience in one of the most biodiverse destinations on Earth.
hero.footnote: No commitment. In 15 minutes we'll explain everything about the program.

problema.text: While others teach you technique, at Hevristika we change your reality. One month in Misiones to gain professional level, real connections, and an experience few in the world can tell.
problema.card1Title: Misiones: your natural campus in Puerto Lagier
problema.card1Text: Forget traditional classrooms. Train in a unique environment designed to take your technique and mindset to the next level. A total immersion cocktail academy you won't find in any other city.
problema.card2Text: At Hevristika you don't just learn recipes. You learn to think like a bartender: read a bar, understand the client, design experiences, work under pressure, and build a professional identity. You leave with real tools to work in bars, events, hotels, restaurants, or your own projects.

queEs.label: What is Hevristika
queEs.title: A professional bartender academy in the heart of the Misiones jungle.
queEs.subtitle: Hevristika is an intensive cocktail academy located in Misiones, Argentina, very close to Iguazú Falls. It was created by two Argentine bartenders with real bar experience, international training, and a clear vision: to bring a professional, human, and sensory standard to an unforgettable destination.
queEs.pillar1Desc: Hands-on training from day one, with professional standards applied to real bar situations.
queEs.pillar2Desc: You live and learn in Misiones, a region shaped by jungle, culture, biodiversity, and its own gastronomic identity.
queEs.pillar3Desc: Hevristika graduates are part of a real network of people who collaborate, recommend each other, and keep growing together.

fundadoras.label: The founders
fundadoras.title: Two bartenders. One shared vision.
fundadoras.intro1: Hevristika was born from the union of science, technique, sustainability, sensibility, real experience, and a different way of understanding hospitality.
fundadoras.intro2: Behind the project are Sofía Lagier and Verónica Báez: two Argentine professionals who decided to create an academy where mixology is learned with rigor, criteria, identity, and human connection.
fundadoras.card1Desc: Professional bartender with international training in Thailand, experience in mixology, education, and experience development. Her approach combines technique, strategy, creativity, and a sensory perspective on hospitality.
fundadoras.card2Desc: Professional bartender and bar manager, with experience in bar service, training, and operations. Her perspective brings structure, precision, technical criteria, and a deep understanding of the real work behind a high-level experience.
fundadoras.outro: Together they designed Hevristika as a living academy: scientific, rigorous, human, practical, and deeply connected to the territory.

hevristika.label: Hevristika
hevristika.title: Our way of learning.
hevristika.text1: Hevristika starts from a simple idea: you learn best when you discover, try, correct, and try again.
hevristika.text2: The bar works as a human laboratory: technique, error, real service, sensory judgment, and decision-making under pressure.
hevristika.text3: We don't give closed answers. We design conditions for each student to find their voice, their judgment, and their way of creating.

programa.label: Programs
programa.title: Choose your immersion level: programs designed with no filler.
programa.subtitle: Hands-on training to develop precision, speed, judgment, and confidence behind the bar.

card1Items.title: Sustainable Mixology
card1Items.desc: Ingredient development, waste reduction, and menu design with seasonal criteria.

card1Items.title: Flair Techniques
card1Items.desc: Equipment handling, presentation moves, and visual techniques applied to high-end venues.

card1Items.title: Free Pouring
card1Items.desc: Precision without a jigger, measure control, and muscle memory training for fluid workflow.

card2Items.title: Professional Bar Operations
card2Items.desc: Costs, yields, service organization, speed, floor reading, mise en place, quality standards, and decision-making under pressure.

card2Items.title: Career Projection

foodpairing.label: Foodpairing & Biotechnology
foodpairing.title: Foodpairing & Biotechnology
foodpairing.subtitle: A sensory laboratory where science, flavor, and hospitality come together to create a new generation of bartenders.

cards.title: Applied Biotechnology
cards.desc: Controlled fermentation, clarification, enzyme use, smart preservation, and creation of house-made ingredients for a more technical, sustainable, and creative mixology.

cards.title: Scientific Foodpairing
cards.desc: You learn to work with aromatic molecules, flavor architecture, sensory bridges, and pairings applied to contemporary mixology.

cards.title: Experience Design
cards.desc: It's not just about making cocktails. It's about creating memorable moments through flavor, aesthetics, service, and narrative.

destino.label: The destination
destino.title: Misiones isn't just where you study. It's part of what you learn.
destino.sub1: Misiones is the northeasternmost province of Argentina. It borders Brazil and Paraguay, covered in subtropical jungle. It is home to Iguazú Falls — one of the natural wonders of the world.
destino.sub2: Living here for a month isn't just studying in a beautiful place. It's leaving with references that no program in Buenos Aires or Europe can give you.

cards.title: International level. Immersive experience.
cards.desc: From zero to professional bartender combining practice, hospitality, science, and immersive experience in Misiones, Argentina. A competitive investment compared to many international schools, with much more support, practical depth, and human connection.

cards.title: Real environment, not simulated
cards.desc: You learn in a real workspace, with professional bar standards and applied situations from day one.

cards.title: Small groups
cards.desc: Limited spots so each student gets direct follow-up, personalized correction, and a deeper experience.

cards.title: Working founders
cards.desc: Learn with active professionals, not disconnected theory from service reality.

cards.title: Active alumni network
cards.desc: A real community that collaborates, recommends, and stays connected after the program.

cards.title: Total flexibility
cards.desc: We facilitate and guide you on accommodation, transfers, logistics, and additional experiences.

items.q: Do I need a visa to enter Argentina?
items.a: It depends on your country of origin. Most European and South American countries have a free entry agreement with Argentina for stays up to 90 days. If you have questions about your specific case, we'll confirm it on the call.

items.q: Where do I stay during the program?
items.a: For international students, we provide guidance on accommodation options near the facilities. The Complete Experience (USD 4,200) includes accommodation. On the call, we'll detail the options available based on your budget and preference.

items.q: Is the program in Spanish? Can I follow it if I don't speak Spanish well?
items.a: The program is taught in Spanish. If your Spanish level is basic, talk to us on the call — based on your profile we'll assess together whether it's viable and how to support you during the program.

items.q: What prior bartending level do I need?
items.a: No prior experience is necessary. The program is designed so that both beginners and those with prior experience can make the most of the four weeks. If you already have experience, on the call we'll assess which aspects of the program add the most value for you.
Yes. On the call, we'll explain the payment options available for international students.

items.q: What happens if I need to change the date after enrolling?
items.a: There is flexibility for date changes with prior notice. The exact conditions will be explained in detail during the call.
